newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: VNU POSTS 16 PCT PROFIT RISE IN 1996.
newsitem.headline: VNU POSTS 16 PCT PROFIT RISE IN 1996.

text.p: Dutch publisher NV Verenigd Bezit VNU said on Tuesday its 1996 net profit from ordinary operations rose 16 percent to 316 million guilders from 274 million in 1995.
VNU -- whose businesses span consumer magazines, business information and commercial TV -- said it would pay a dividend of 0.55 guilders per share, up from 0.48 guilders in 1995.
The 1996 results were in line with analysts' expectations of a net profit from ordinary operations of 312 to 317 million.

Overall net profit, including extraordinary items, fell to 322 million guilders from 430 million in 1995 when it was swollen by an extraordinary gain of 157 million guilders on the sale of U.S. financial information unit Disclosure.
VNU said it expected its net profit and ordinary earnings per share to rise in 1997.

It said it expected a "clear" increase in earnings this year from consumer magazines, educational publishing and Business Information Europe plus a "significant" rise in earnings from newspapers and Business Information USA.
VNU said market conditions for commercial television remained "uncertain" but that it expected "some improvement" in results this year after a one million guilder loss in 1996.
